skill.summary: Coordinates multi-agent collaboration by decomposing tasks, managing dependencies, scheduling execution, and aggregating results in a task orchestration system.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Multi-Agent Orchestrator skill.
- Designs and manages multi-agent collaboration, task routing, and state management.
- Includes agent base class, orchestrator for task decomposition and scheduling, message bus, and agent state manager.
- Supports various communication modes (broadcast, point-to-point, pub/sub, blackboard) and orchestration patterns (role play, debate).
- Provides mechanisms for agent registration, concurrent execution, dependency management, and communication.
